heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 683(a), Aug. 13, 1981, 95 Stat. 519

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 88–452, title II, § 201, Aug. 20, 1964, 78 Stat. 516; Pub. L. 90–222, title I, § 104, Dec. 23, 1967, 81 Stat. 690; Pub. L. 94–341, § 2(a)(6), July 6, 1976, 90 Stat. 803, set forth Congressional statement of purpose for urban and rural community action programs.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Oct. 1, 1981, see section 9912(a) of this title, prior to the general amendment of chapter 106 (§ 9901 et seq.) of this title by Pub. L. 105–285.
